sections.title: 一、看图听句子
sections.instruction: 看图听句子,判断图片是否与听到的内容一致,一致的用“T”表示,不一致的用“F”表示。

[HTML: <svg viewBox="0 0 196 216" width="196" height="216" style="display:block; margin:8px auto; border-radius:8px; border:1px solid #e2e8f0;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">

</svg>]

audio.text: He wants to buy a big birthday cake.

questions.translation: 他想买一个大生日蛋糕。
questions.explanation: 听力原文为: He wants to buy a big birthday cake. 与生日蛋糕图片一致。

audio.text: The shopkeeper is nice to the kid.

questions.translation: 店主对这个孩子很友善。
questions.explanation: 听力原文为: The shopkeeper is nice to the kid. 与店主在柜台服务顾客图片一致。

questions.translation: 她上周日去买了一些花。

questions.explanation: 听力原文为: She went to buy an ice cream with her pocket money. 与女孩买/吃冰淇淋图片一致。

sections.title: 二、看图听对话
sections.instruction: 看图听对话,根据听到的内容选择恰当的选项。

questions.prompt: How much pocket money does Lily get every week?
questions.translation: 莉莉每周得到多少零花钱？
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文 Lily 所说: "I get 30 yuan, but I usually spend about 15 yuan every week." 可知她每周得到30元。故选 C。

audio.text:
Lily: Leo, how much pocket money do you get every week?
Leo: I get 20 yuan every week. What about you, Lily?
Lily: I get 30 yuan, but I usually spend about 15 yuan every week.
Leo: What do you do with the leftover money?
Lily: I save it.
Leo: Oh, That's a really good habit!

questions.prompt: Which robot does Max buy at last?
questions.translation: 马克斯最后买了哪个机器人？
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文: Amy 建议 "It's only 45 yuan, and it's good, too." Max 回答 "Great! I'll take this one." 可知他买了45元的机器人。故选 B。

audio.text:
Amy: Max, which robot would you like to buy?
Max: I like the 65-yuan robot, but it's a little bit expensive.
Amy: What about the cheaper one? It's only 45 yuan, and it's good, too.
Max: Great! I'll take this one.

questions.translation: 凯文打算用他的零花钱做什么？
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文 Kevin 说: "No, I'll buy him a pair of shoes for Father's Day." 可知他要买一双鞋。故选 C (皮鞋)。

audio.text:
Lucy: Kevin, what will you do with your pocket money?
Kevin: I want to buy my dad a gift.
Lucy: Will you get him a T-shirt?
Kevin: No, I'll buy him a pair of shoes for Father's Day.

questions.translation: 卡罗尔在哪里？
questions.explanation: 根据对话内容 Carol 想买 a new dress 并试穿，可知她在服装店。故选 A (服装店)。

audio.text:
Shopkeeper: Can I help you?
Carol: Yes, please. I want a new dress for a party.
Shopkeeper: How about this pink one?
Carol: It looks pretty! How much is it?
Shopkeeper: Let me check. It's 150 yuan.
Carol: OK. Can I try it on?
Shopkeeper: Sure. This way, please.

questions.translation: 玛丽将怎么做来省钱？
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文 Mary 说: "I won't buy ice cream anymore." 可知她不再买冰淇淋。故选 C (禁止冰淇淋)。

audio.text:
Dad: Mary, you want to save money, right?
Mary: Yes. I plan to buy a new schoolbag.
Dad: Will you stop buying toys every week?
Mary: No, I still like toys.
Dad: Then how will you save money?
Mary: I won't buy ice cream anymore.

sections.title: 三、听力理解 (第一段对话)
sections.instruction: 请听第一段对话,完成第1、2小题。

audio.text:
Alice: Hi, Eric. You look really happy today.
Eric: Yeah! I got my pocket money this morning.
Alice: That's wonderful! How do you usually get your pocket money?
Eric: I help my parents with housework. What about you, Alice?
Alice: I sell my old books and toys near our community. It works well.
Eric: That's smart.
Alice: Oh, the bell is ringing. Class is about to start.

questions.prompt: How does Alice get her pocket money?
questions.translation: 爱丽丝是如何获得零花钱的？
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文 Alice 说: "I sell my old books and toys near our community." 可知是通过卖旧物品。故选 B。

questions.prompt: Where are they probably talking?
questions.translation: 他们可能在哪里交谈？
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文 Alice 说: "Oh, the bell is ringing. Class is about to start." 可知在上课铃响，他们在学校。故选 B。

sections.title: 四、听力理解 (第二段对话)
sections.instruction: 请听第二段对话,完成第3、4、5小题。

audio.text:
Bill: Hi, Helen. Children's Day is coming. I want to help the children in the care home. Do you want to join me?
Helen: That's a wonderful idea! I'd love to.
Bill: I have many nice clothes and storybooks. I want to donate them on that day.
Helen: Wow, that's so kind of you!
Bill: What will you do to help them, Helen?
Helen: I have some pocket money. I want to buy new pencils and notebooks for the kids there.
Bill: That's really nice! I think helping others makes us feel happy too.

questions.prompt: What does Bill want to donate to the children?
questions.translation: 比尔想给孩子们捐赠什么？
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文 Bill 说: "I have many nice clothes and storybooks. I want to donate them on that day." 故选 B。

questions.prompt: What will Helen use her pocket money to buy?
questions.translation: 海伦会用她的零花钱买什么？
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文 Helen 说: "I want to buy new pencils and notebooks for the kids there." 故选 B。

questions.prompt: What is the main topic of the dialogue?
options: Their plans to help children in the care home.
How to buy storybooks and pencils for friends.
Different ways to make pocket money.
questions.translation: 这段对话的主题是什么？
questions.explanation: 对话围绕六一儿童节去儿童福利院帮助孩子们展开，故选 A。

sections.title: 五、听短文判断正误
sections.instruction: 听短文,根据短文内容判断句子是否与所听到的内容一致,一致的用“T”表示,不一致的用“F”表示。

audio.text: Bob wants a new bike, so he makes a plan to save pocket money. Before, he often ate out and bought expensive snacks and sweet drinks. Now, he decides to eat at home more and stop buying those things. He eats healthily and brings water to school every day. Little by little, he saves a lot of pocket money. Now he has enough money for the bike, and he also has a healthier diet and feels much better.

questions.prompt: Bob makes a plan to save money for a new game.
questions.translation: 鲍勃制定了一个存钱买新游戏的计划。
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文: "Bob wants a new bike, so he makes a plan to save pocket money." 他是为了买新自行车，不是新游戏。

questions.prompt: Bob spent a lot on unhealthy food before.
questions.translation: 鲍勃以前在不健康的食物上花了很多钱。
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文: "Before, he often ate out and bought expensive snacks and sweet drinks." 描述相符。

questions.prompt: Bob stops buying expensive snacks now.
questions.translation: 鲍勃现在不再买昂贵的零食了。
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文: "Now, he decides to eat at home more and stop buying those things." 描述相符。

questions.prompt: Bob brings sweet drinks to school every day.
questions.translation: 鲍勃每天带甜饮料去学校。
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文: "brings water to school every day"，他是带水而不是甜饮料。

questions.prompt: At last, Bob has enough money for his goal and feels healthier.
questions.translation: 最后，鲍勃有了足够的钱实现目标，而且感觉更健康。
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文: "Now he has enough money for the bike, and he also has a healthier diet and feels much better." 描述相符。

sections.title: 六、听短文补全信息卡
sections.instruction: 听短文,根据所听内容把信息卡补充完整。

audio.text: My name is Daniel, D-A-N-I-E-L, Daniel. I am eleven years old. I love playing football. Last year, I wanted a new football. It was not cheap, so I made a clever plan. I didn't buy snacks or toys with my money. I saved five to ten yuan each week and kept money in my piggy bank. Soon I got enough money and bought the football. I felt really happy. Now I play it every day.

sections.passage:
### Daniel's Clever Plan
* **Name:** [1]
* **Age:** [2]
* **His clever plan for his pocket money:**
  * didn't buy [3] or toys
  * [4] five to ten yuan each week
  * [5] his money in his piggy bank (存钱罐)

questions.prompt: Name
questions.translation: 姓名: Daniel
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文: "My name is Daniel, D-A-N-I-E-L, Daniel."

questions.prompt: Age
questions.translation: 年龄: 11 / eleven
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文: "I am eleven years old."

questions.prompt: didn't buy ______ or toys
questions.translation: 没有买零食或玩具
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文: "I didn't buy snacks or toys with my money."

questions.prompt: ______ five to ten yuan each week
questions.translation: 每周存5到10元
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文: "I saved five to ten yuan each week"

questions.prompt: ______ his money in his piggy bank
questions.translation: 把钱保存在存钱罐里
questions.explanation: 根据听力原文: "and kept money in my piggy bank"

sections.title: 八、词义理解
sections.instruction: 读句子,找出与其含义相符的单词,将相应的标号填写在括号内。

questions.prompt: 1. It means to use your money to pay for goods or services.
questions.translation: 它意味着用你的钱来支付商品或服务。
questions.explanation: spend 意为花费金钱，故选 E。

questions.prompt: 2. It's a person who owns a small shop.
questions.translation: 这是一个拥有一家小店的人。
questions.explanation: shopkeeper 意为店主，故选 C。

questions.prompt: 3. It means having a bright yellow colour like gold.
questions.translation: 它意味着拥有像金子一样明亮的黄色。
questions.explanation: golden 意为金色的，故选 B。

questions.prompt: 4. It means to make a loud ringing sound when metal hits.
questions.translation: 它意味着金属撞击时发出响亮的当啷声。
questions.explanation: clang 意为当啷声，故选 A。

questions.prompt: 5. It means having a feeling of surprise.
questions.translation: 它意味着感到惊讶。
questions.explanation: surprised 意为感到惊讶的，故选 D。

sections.title: 九、补全对话
sections.instruction: 读对话,选择最佳选项,将对话补充完整,将其标号填在横线上。

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.text: I don't spend money on sweets or toys anymore.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: That's cool! So what do you spend your pocket money on?

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.text: [2] I leave food for them every evening after school.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: [3] Do you use your money for other things as well?

dialogue.speaker: Amy
dialogue.text: Sure. [4] I watch them grow every day.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.text: Wow! You spend your money in such great ways.

options: A. I buy food for little homeless dogs in our community.
B. What do you usually do with your pocket money?
C. I also buy sunflower seeds to plant by my window.
D. You are so nice to do that.
E. These small things make me very happy.

questions.answer: B. What do you usually do with your pocket money?
questions.translation: 你通常怎么处理你的零花钱？
questions.explanation: 下文 Amy 回答关于如何花费零花钱，此处应提出相关问题，故选 B。

questions.answer: A. I buy food for little homeless dogs in our community.
questions.translation: 我为我们社区里的无家可归的小狗买食物。
questions.explanation: 根据下文 "I leave food for them every evening" 可知是买食物给小狗，故选 A。

questions.answer: D. You are so nice to do that.
questions.translation: 你这么做真是太好了。
questions.explanation: 听到 Amy 照顾流浪狗，Tom 发出赞美，故选 D。

questions.answer: C. I also buy sunflower seeds to plant by my window.
questions.translation: 我还买向日葵种子种在窗边。
questions.explanation: 根据下文 "I watch them grow every day" 可知种植植物，故选 C。

questions.answer: E. These small things make me very happy.
questions.translation: 这些小事让我非常快乐。
questions.explanation: 作为对话的总结感受，故选 E。

sections.title: 十、完形填空
sections.instruction: 阅读短文,根据短文内容,选择恰当的单词,将其标号填入题前括号内。
sections.passage: Last Sunday, Lucy [1] to buy a gift for her little sister. With her pocket money, she [2] a new box of crayons. Her sister was very happy and [3] a nice picture for her. The picture had lots of beautiful [4]. Lucy liked it [5] it was bright and lovely.

questions.translation: 上周日，露西去给妹妹买礼物。
questions.explanation: 根据时间状语 Last Sunday，动词用过去式 went，故选 B。

questions.translation: 用她的零花钱，她买了一盒新蜡笔。
questions.explanation: 叙述过去的事情，动词用过去式 bought，故选 B。

questions.translation: 她的妹妹非常开心，并为她画了一幅好看的画。
questions.explanation: and 连接并列谓语，与 was 一致用过去式 drew，故选 B。

questions.translation: 这幅画有许多美丽的色彩。
questions.explanation: 画作中有美丽的色彩 colours，故选 B。

questions.translation: 露西很喜欢它，因为它是那么鲜艳可爱。
questions.explanation: 前后句为因果关系，用 because，故选 A。

sections.title: 十一、连环画填空
sections.instruction: 读图片短文,选择恰当的单词,将其标号填入题前括号内。
sections.passage:
* (A) 1. Yesterday, Ryan [1] a little money by painting the neighbour's fence.
* 2. He went to the [2] in the town and saw a book and a toy plane.

* 5. He picked the book up again and then looked outside. Oh! It started to [5].
* 6. At last, Ryan [6] an umbrella and the book. Then he went home happily.

questions.translation: 昨天，赖恩通过粉刷邻居的篱笆得到了一点钱。
questions.explanation: 根据题意，第1题作为示例给出 A (got)。

questions.translation: 他去了镇上的商店，看到了一本书和一个玩具飞机。
questions.explanation: 去镇上的商店 shop，对应选项 B。

questions.translation: 他想要那本书和玩具飞机，但他没有足够的钱。
questions.explanation: 连接并列宾语 book 和 toy plane 用 and，对应选项 C。

questions.translation: 他反复思考了很久。
questions.explanation: thought over and over 意为反复思考，对应选项 F。

questions.translation: 噢！天开始下雨了。

questions.translation: 最后，赖恩买了一把雨伞和那本书。

sections.title: 十二、阅读海报判断正误
sections.instruction: 阅读下面的“跳蚤市场海报”,判断句子是否与其内容一致,一致的在括号中用“T”表示,不一致的用“F”表示。
sections.passage:
# Flea Market, Warm Hearts!

**Time:** This Saturday morning, 9:00-11:00
**Place:** School Playground
**Things to sell:** Used storybooks, picture books, pencil cases, crayons, notebooks, soft toys, blocks, handmade cards, and paper crafts.
All money will be used to help children in need.

**~Tips~**
1. Please bring cheap and clean things only. Do not bring expensive toys or electronics(电子产品).
2. Be polite, friendly and keep the playground clean.
3. Bring a small bag for coins and paper money.

questions.prompt: 1. The flea market is on Saturday morning.
questions.translation: 跳蚤市场在周六上午举行。
questions.explanation: 根据海报: "Time: This Saturday morning, 9:00-11:00"，表述正确。

questions.prompt: 2. You can see the flea market in school hall.
questions.translation: 你可以在学校礼堂看到跳蚤市场。
questions.explanation: 根据海报: "Place: School Playground"，地点在操场而不是礼堂，表述错误。

questions.prompt: 3. Students can sell handmade cards and used storybooks.
questions.translation: 学生可以卖手工卡片和二手故事书。
questions.explanation: 根据海报: "Used storybooks... handmade cards"，表述正确。

questions.prompt: 4. If you have an expensive cellphone, you can bring it to sell.
questions.translation: 如果你有一部昂贵的手机，你可以带去卖。
questions.explanation: 根据海报 Tips 1: "Do not bring expensive toys or electronics(电子产品)"，手机属于电子产品，不能带去卖。

questions.prompt: 5. The flea market helps students learn to help children in need.
questions.translation: 跳蚤市场帮助学生学会关爱有需要的孩子。
questions.explanation: 根据海报: "All money will be used to help children in need."，表述正确。

sections.title: 十三、阅读理解 A
sections.instruction: 阅读下面的文章,根据文章内容选择正确选项,将相应的标号填入题前括号内。
sections.passage:
# How to Make and Use Pocket Money Wisely

Many kids want to have more pocket money for books, gifts or fun things. But how can we make and use pocket money in good ways? Here are some helpful ideas.

First, you can help your parents with chores at home, such as washing dishes, tidying desks, walking dogs or watering plants. Your parents will be happy and give you money as a reward.

Second, you can sell old things like books, toys or cards at a community sale. People may buy them, and you can get extra money.

Third, you should learn to save and use money carefully. Don't spend money on expensive snacks or useless toys. Put some money into your savings box every week.

Making and planning money well helps you understand the value of hard work. It also makes you a careful and responsible kid.

questions.prompt: 1. What is the way kids can get pocket money at home?
questions.translation: 孩子们在家里获得零花钱的方式是什么？
questions.explanation: 根据文章第二段: "First, you can help your parents with chores at home... give you money as a reward." 故选 A。

questions.prompt: 2. What can kids sell to make extra money?
questions.translation: 孩子们可以卖什么来赚取额外的钱？
questions.explanation: 根据文章第三段: "Second, you can sell old things like books, toys or cards at a community sale." 故选 A。

questions.prompt: 3. What should you NOT spend money on?
questions.translation: 你不应该在什么上面花钱？
questions.explanation: 根据文章第四段: "Don't spend money on expensive snacks or useless toys." 故选 B。

questions.prompt: 4. From the passage, making and planning money well helps kids ______.
options: know the value of hard work
questions.translation: 从文章中可以看出，合理赚钱和规划金钱有助于孩子们______。
questions.explanation: 根据文章最后一段: "Making and planning money well helps you understand the value of hard work." 故选 A。

questions.prompt: 5. What is the main idea of the passage?
options: How to make and use pocket money wisely.
questions.translation: 这篇文章的主旨大意是什么？
questions.explanation: 文章标题和全文围绕 "How to Make and Use Pocket Money Wisely" 展开，故选 A。

sections.title: 十四、阅读理解 B
sections.instruction: 阅读下面的文章,根据文章内容选择正确选项,将相应的标号填入题前括号内。
sections.passage:
# The History of Money

Long ago, people did not use money. They gave things to each other to get what they needed. Later, people used shells, beads(珠子),fur, and grain as money.

About 3,000 years ago, people made the first coins in Lydia(吕底亚,小亚细亚古国). These coins were made of a mix of gold and silver. China was the first country to use paper money. Early people in America used shells, animal fur, tobacco, and different kinds of coins as money.

Today, money keeps changing. We use coins, paper money, bank cards, and phone payments to buy things. Using money is much easier than giving things to each other directly. It helps people buy and sell things easily, and keep their money safe, too. Learning about the history of money helps us know how people lived in the past.

questions.prompt: 1. What did people do long ago before money was invented?
options: They gave things to each other.
questions.translation: 在货币发明之前，很久以前人们是怎么做的？
questions.explanation: 根据文章第一段: "Long ago, people did not use money. They gave things to each other to get what they needed." 故选 B。

questions.prompt: 2. Where were the first coins made?
questions.translation: 最早的硬币是在哪里制造的？
questions.explanation: 根据文章第二段: "About 3,000 years ago, people made the first coins in Lydia." 故选 B。

questions.prompt: 3. Which country was the first to use paper money?
questions.translation: 哪个国家最早使用纸币？
questions.explanation: 根据文章第二段: "China was the first country to use paper money." 故选 A。

questions.prompt: 4. From the passage, we can learn that using money is ______.
options: harder than giving things to each other directly
easier than giving things to each other directly
impossible for kids to use in daily life
questions.translation: 从文章中我们可以了解到，使用货币______。
questions.explanation: 根据文章第三段: "Using money is much easier than giving things to each other directly." 故选 B。

questions.prompt: 5. What is the main idea of the passage?
questions.translation: 这篇文章的主旨大意是什么？
questions.explanation: 文章讲述了从物物交换到硬币、纸币再到现代电子支付的演变历史，即货币是如何变迁发展的，故选 C。
